description: This Java source file defines the RootRoute class responsible for constructing and managing the primary HTTP routes for the '/api' and '/ws' endpoints in an Akka HTTP-based API gateway. It configures routes for health checks, status, DevOps, policies, WebSocket, things, search, and additional custom API routes, with extensive directive wrapping for security, HTTPS enforcement, CORS, and exception handling.
external_methods: Verification and invocation of all route-building methods in Builder

classes.name: RootRoute
classes.description: Main class responsible for building and managing the primary Akka HTTP routes for the API gateway, including configuration for security, HTTPS, CORS, and various resource sub-routes.

classes.name: RootRoute.Builder
classes.description: Builder inner class implementing a fluent API for configuring and constructing an instance of RootRoute with all dependencies and route configurations.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Static method to obtain a new Builder instance with default configuration.

methods.name: buildRoute
methods.description: Constructs the Akka HTTP Route for the root path, wrapping all sub-routes and directives.

methods.name: wrapWithRootDirectives
methods.description: Wraps the main route with exception handling, correlation ID, timeout, request logging, encoding, HTTPS, CORS, and rejection handling directives.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Handles configuration and routing for '/api' paths, including versioning and custom multi-tenant API sub-routes.

methods.name: ensureSchemaVersion
methods.description: Validates and extracts the API or WebSocket schema version based on URL path segments.

methods.name: apiAuthentication
methods.description: Performs authentication for the API based on provided headers and schema version.

methods.name: buildApiSubRoutes
methods.description: Builds sub-routes under '/api/{version}' including policies, things, search, and whoami.

methods.name: buildSseThingsRoute
methods.description: Configures server-sent events (SSE) route for '/api/{version}/things' with appropriate headers.

methods.name: overwriteDittoHeadersForSse
methods.description: Overrides or adds headers specifically for SSE connections.

methods.name: ws
methods.description: Handles configuration and routing for WebSocket connections under '/ws/{version}'.

methods.name: wsAuthentication
methods.description: Performs authentication for WebSocket routes based on headers and schema version.

methods.name: getUserAgentOrNull
methods.description: Extracts the User-Agent header from the request, if present.

methods.name: withDittoHeaders
methods.description: Wraps a route with a promise of DittoHeaders, ensuring headers are managed asynchronously.

methods.name: javaFunctionToRoute
methods.description: Converts a Java function into an Akka Route.

methods.name: routeToJavaFunction
methods.description: Converts an Akka Route into a Java function taking RequestContext and returning a Future of RouteResult.
